title: Microsoft Teams: Awards and Certifications badges on profile cards
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, automatic display, Teams licensing and both Graph deletion operations are supported. The admin navigation has one minor documentation discrepancy: the People settings access guide includes the Services tab, which the profile card guide omits.
